pk.context: 60 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

tell: A proton pump inhibitor whose dual delayed-release granules give two separate plasma concentration peaks.

clues.text: Food increases Cmax by 12% to 55% and AUC by 9% to 37%. Protein binding is 96% to 99%, and the drug is extensively metabolized in the liver.
The active moiety has a molecular weight of 369.4. It is a crystalline powder that melts with decomposition at 140°C.
Approved under an NDA as 30 mg and 60 mg delayed-release capsules, dosed once daily.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated with hypersensitivity to any component and with rilpivirine-containing products; diarrhea and abdominal pain are common.
Healing of erosive esophagitis of all grades, maintenance of healing with relief of heartburn, and symptomatic non-erosive reflux disease, in patients 12 years and older.
Specifically inhibits the (H+, K+)-ATPase at the secretory surface of the gastric parietal cell, blocking the final step of acid production.
The generic name begins with D and has fifteen letters.
